findings.highlight: Her words are merely something she must ask as a Master
findings.evidenceJa: あくまで平等に、自分の意志を混ぜず、マスターとして問いかけた言葉
findings.governingReading: she asks impartially as a Master, without mixing in her own will
findings.explanation: Rin’s deliberate neutral stance becomes an externally imposed obligation to ask.

findings.governingReading: without mixing in her own will
findings.explanation: The distinction between outward neutrality and private volition becomes absence of personal concern.
mirror moon replaces Shirou’s terse rejection of the offered retreat with an explicit declaration supplied by the following explanation.

findings.evidenceJa: 今はその心遣いだけを、忘れないように覚えていよう
findings.governingReading: for now he will remember that consideration alone and make sure not to forget it
findings.explanation: The private, carefully bounded acknowledgment of Rin’s kindness loses its temporal and exclusive limits and gains a contrastive “though.”
Lack of desire is moralized into altruistic virtue, obscuring Rin’s warning about susceptibility to outside motives.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分以外のものに引きずられる
findings.governingReading: pulled along by things outside oneself
findings.explanation: The range of external goals and circumstances that can move Shirou is narrowed to other persons.

findings.governingReading: he might use the Grail because circumstances leave no choice
they would be enemies just as they have been until now
findings.explanation: The continuity Rin treats as ordinary is reduced to bare current status.

findings.highlight: She looks at me as if she’s seen a ghost
findings.evidenceJa: お化けをみるような目で、まじまじと俺を見た
findings.governingReading: she stares fixedly at him as though looking at a ghost
findings.explanation: The sustained scrutiny showing how completely Shirou’s request surprises Rin is omitted.

findings.highlight: I need you as an ally
findings.evidenceJa: 休戦するんじゃなくて、協力者として助力してほしい
findings.governingReading: he wants her help as a collaborator rather than merely a truce
findings.explanation: The central distinction Shirou is negotiating is collapsed into a generic label.

findings.highlight: I can’t help someone who can’t help me in return
findings.evidenceJa: 釣りあわない技術者に手を貸す事も出来ない
findings.governingReading: one cannot lend assistance to a practitioner whose skill or standing is not commensurate
findings.explanation: Rin’s analogy about mismatched technical partners becomes simple reciprocal favor exchange.

findings.governingReading: makes her words evasive or trails off
findings.explanation: Even within the improperly activated variant, Rin’s verbal evasion is mistranslated as low volume.

findings.highlight: I’m fully aware that I’m only a burden on her
findings.evidenceJa: 迷惑だって事は百も承知だ
findings.governingReading: he knows perfectly well that the request is an imposition
findings.explanation: A judgment about the inconvenience of asking becomes a global self-description as Rin’s burden.

findings.highlight: I can trust her to do no wrong even if she obtains the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を得るのが遠坂なら、何の間違いも起きないと信じられる
findings.governingReading: he trusts that nothing disastrous or mistaken will occur if Rin is the one who obtains the Grail
findings.explanation: Confidence in one specific outcome becomes blanket moral infallibility, while “even if” makes Rin obtaining it sound adverse.

findings.evidenceJa: 真っ直ぐにこっちを見返してきた
findings.governingReading: she sharply meets his gaze straight on
findings.explanation: The reciprocal recovery from looking down is reduced to hostility.
